highlights: Own AI Engineering within the Cybersecurity practice: shipped two production platforms — a chat/event-driven AI platform for regulated and high-security environments, and an AI batch processing platform ('AIETL') enabling developers to build AI processing pipelines at scale.
Drove $50M+ in first-year revenue growth with $100M+ in qualified pipeline, establishing AI Engineering as a flagship growth engine within Cybersecurity.
Lead 13 engineering teams with overlapping dependencies, coordinating delivery across identity, TVM, compliance, appsec, policy, and governance domains.

Architected a fully automated compliance assessment framework — from framework selection/creation through questionnaire generation, answer extraction, assessment processing, and report generation — covering all major compliance frameworks.

Pioneered novel AI processing techniques combining agentic workflows, multi-agent conversations, and multi-model processing to extract relevant information from unstructured data and eliminate hallucinations.
AIETL batch processing platform adopted by 3 additional EY divisions, validating the platform's scalability and cross-practice applicability.
Delivered 64 full-featured assets, 10 client-ready demos for sales teams, and 200+ technical enablers for internal and client-facing scenarios.
Participated in 21 industry events as speaker, panelist, or workshop leader, sharing insights on AI engineering and cybersecurity.
Deliver SOC automation (LLM-powered triage, investigation, orchestration) integrated with SOAR/case management; achieving 40–95% cost reduction depending on task complexity.

initiatives.name: Conversational AI Platform (Regulated Environments)

initiatives.approach: Designed and shipped a production conversational AI platform architected for deployment into regulated environments, with governance, auditability, and security built in from day one.
initiatives.outcome: Deployed across client engagements; became a core offering within the Cybersecurity AI portfolio.

initiatives.name: AIETL Batch Processing Platform
initiatives.problem: Developers needed a scalable way to build AI processing pipelines without reinventing data flow orchestration for every project.
initiatives.approach: Coined and built the 'AIETL' paradigm — an ETL-inspired platform for AI batch processing, enabling developers to compose AI processing pipelines with standardized patterns.
initiatives.outcome: Adopted by 3 additional EY divisions beyond Cybersecurity; became a reusable enterprise asset.

initiatives.name: Automated Compliance Assessment Framework

initiatives.outcome: End-to-end automation covering all major compliance frameworks; dramatically reduced assessment cycle time.

initiatives.name: SOC Agentic Automation
initiatives.problem: Manual L1/L2 triage and investigation slows response and increases cost.
initiatives.approach: Agentic workflows for triage, investigation, and orchestration using novel multi-agent and multi-model processing techniques to eliminate hallucinations; deeply integrated with enterprise tooling.
initiatives.outcome: 40–95% cost reduction depending on task complexity; accelerated response in client engagements.

initiatives.name: Agentic AI Pioneering
initiatives.problem: AI systems lacked autonomous decision-making capabilities and inter-agent communication standards; no industry terminology or patterns existed.
initiatives.approach: Developed early prototypes of agentic architectures with inter-agent communication protocols predating MCP, built a tiered agentic microservices framework, and independently designed an agentic authentication model using the same paradigm later standardized industry-wide as Agent365.
initiatives.outcome: Positioned Accenture as one of the first firms to market with truly agentic AI systems; authentication approach independently validated by industry convergence on the same pattern.

initiatives.name: Knowledge Management System (Graph)
initiatives.problem: Critical knowledge was fragmented across tools and tribal memory, slowing delivery and increasing rework.
initiatives.approach: Built a graph of assets and relationships plus automation for discovery and consistency; integrated into delivery workflows.
initiatives.outcome: Reduced time spent on discovery by ~40% and improved delivery throughput.

initiatives.name: Engineering Upskilling (Code Camp)
initiatives.problem: Inconsistent scripting/automation skills created bottlenecks and avoidable operational toil.
initiatives.approach: Designed and ran an internal upskilling program focused on practical automation, repeatable patterns, and operational rigor.
initiatives.outcome: Raised baseline competency and enabled broader self-service automation across the practice.

dutiesAndAccomplishments: Pioneered early agentic AI systems before the industry had terminology for them — developed prototypes of agentic architectures and inter-agent communication protocols predating and conceptually parallel to MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Designed and built a framework for tiered agentic microservices, enabling composable AI agent hierarchies with clear responsibility boundaries and orchestration patterns.

Developed an early model of agentic authentication — independently arriving at the same paradigm later standardized industry-wide as Agent365 — establishing a security-first approach to agent identity and authorization.
Singlehandedly drove Accenture's entry into the agentic AI domain with these early innovations, positioning the firm as one of the first to market with truly agentic systems.
Partnered with leadership to define operating practices and reduce attrition while scaling delivery.
Led development of a Knowledge Management System: a rich graph of assets and relationships linked to policies, engagements, opportunities, and other entities; reduced discovery time by ~40%.
Built an API-driven single-page application (ASP.NET + TypeScript) and cloud services (Azure DevOps pipelines, App Services/Functions, Service Bus, Cosmos DB) with hardened governance.

Created and ran 'Code Camp' — an internal engineering upskilling program with weekly sessions reaching thousands of employees, raising scripting and automation competency across the security practice.
Drove infrastructure governance using ARM/Terraform/Ansible patterns and Azure Policy to improve compliance and reduce manual effort.

initiatives.name: Azure Policy Governance Accelerator
initiatives.problem: Large Azure environments needed consistent governance and auditability without manual enforcement, including in air-gapped and highly restricted environments.
initiatives.approach: Built a pure-Python Azure Policy accelerator with zero external dependencies for deployment in secure/air-gapped environments. Enabled rapid deployment of highly complex policy environments with automated change reporting and documentation management.
initiatives.outcome: Generated $200M+ in total engagement reach; governed 100M+ Azure resources at the world's largest bank; initial delivery excellence catalyzed several nine-figure outsourcing engagements.

initiatives.name: Enterprise Cryptographic Posture
initiatives.problem: Enterprise-wide data encryption lacked centralized management and consistent policy enforcement across thousands of applications.
initiatives.approach: Designed and operationalized encryption strategy across 5,000 applications and 100,000 keys using Azure KeyVault, Thales nCipher HSM, Azure Dedicated/Managed HSM, and Thales CCKM.
initiatives.outcome: Established enterprise-wide cryptographic posture with centralized key management and consistent policy enforcement.

dutiesAndAccomplishments: Designed, developed, brought to market, and sold an Azure Policy governance accelerator that became the core delivery driver for security engagements — generating $200M+ in total engagement reach across the practice.

Built the accelerator in pure Python with zero external dependencies, enabling deployment in highly secure, highly restricted, and air-gapped (no-internet) environments — a critical differentiator for regulated clients.

Managed Azure Policy deployments governing up to 100M resources (world's largest bank) across all sub-tenants; second-largest client at 10M resources. Orchestrated rapid deployment of highly complex policy environments with automated change reporting and documentation management. Supervised a team of 8.

Initial delivery excellence and relationship management on Azure Policy engagements enabled account teams to build on early success, contributing to several nine-figure outsourcing deals (details NDA).

Cryptographic Posture Delivery: design, implementation, and operationalization of enterprise-wide data encryption across 5,000 applications and 100,000 keys. Leveraged Azure KeyVault, Thales nCipher HSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, Azure Managed HSM, and Thales CCKM.

Developed comprehensive application development and service delivery security posture prioritizing governance and automatic-healing. Partnered enterprise-wide across Business Units and IT Teams to integrate security via procedure, code, and deployment pipelines.
Oversaw development of training programs disseminating cloud knowledge and skills to 1,000+ internal employees.
Designed and developed custom Big Data reports for Azure utilization and policy compliance using Azure DataFactory, Azure Resource Graph, PowerShell, and Azure DataLake.
